# ProtectedAttempt compatibility golden

`protected-attempt-v0.1.0.json` was generated by a temporary in-package test
compiled from the peeled `v0.1.0` release commit
`4c22b248b2e7f03c28051aaf3105a0d769690f73`. The generator used bytes 0–95
for state, nonce, and PKCE material; bytes 96–119 for the two AES-GCM nonces;
and the fixed context values stored under `expected`.

The fixture intentionally uses Go's default `encoding/json` representation of
`ProtectedAttempt` because consumers may have persisted that exported struct
without a library-owned codec. Its SHA-256 is
`79b8a0559e4db4509a743aaf30a513ea2ffe349a81a3616c56bcbc855f79e05f`.
Do not regenerate it from current source: it is evidence of bytes emitted by
the immutable old release.
